dashboard.revenue: The total money your business has made from sales before any costs or fees are taken out.
dashboard.visitors: The number of unique people who have looked at your website today.
products.inventory: How many items of this product you currently have ready to sell.
products.sku: A short code you can invent to help you organize your items. It stands for Stock Keeping Unit.
payments.payouts: When the money you made from sales is officially moved into your personal or business bank account.
settings.domain: The web address people type into their browser to find your store, like www.yourstorename.com.
agents.hire: Turn on this AI helper so it can start working for your business immediately.
marketing.campaign: A specific plan to promote your business, like sending a newsletter or running a small ad.
